thread:
deploy-bot: Canary promotion blocked for service=ingest-worker tag=2026-05-02: post-publish verification failed: index_digest=sha256:9a1b2c3d storage_digest=sha256:9a1b2cff. Automatic canary hold applied.

maria: saw this in the middle of the 30m change window. publisher returned success but verify step failed immediately after.

dave: pulled the object and ran `sha256sum` 3; storage matches storage_digest. index points to different digest. looks like index write may have been concurrent with a cleanup/rewriter.

tara: is this the same pattern as the other inflight artifact races? we had a suspected indexer rewrite last week.

sre-oncall: checking object store logs now. there are two finalize attempts within 12s of each other for the same key in the same region. raising INC-2026-078.

maria: given the change window and downstream schedules, options: 1) pin to last-good 2026-05-01 to keep releases flowing, 2) force-promote (unsafe), 3) block until triage. i prefer pin for minimal disruption.

release-manager: agree with pin. keep the window open for other services. open ARTIFACT-1521 to investigate indexer/publisher concurrency and add post-finalize verification + per-key lease.

deploy-bot: Usage: `deploybot pin --service ingest-worker --image 2026-05-01 --reason "post-publish index/storage digest mismatch 2026-05-02"`

maria: running pin now:
```
deploybot pin --service ingest-worker --image 2026-05-01 --reason "post-publish index/storage digest mismatch 2026-05-02"
```

deploy-bot: Pin successful. Canary reverted to 2026-05-01; stable routes restored.

dave: created ARTIFACT-1521: "index/publisher race causing digest mismatches; add finalize-verify, per-key leases, integration test". assigning to @dave and @tara.

tara: short remediation plan:
- add immediate post-finalize fetch+verify in publisher and fail publish if mismatch
- acquire short-lived lease for index writes per key to prevent concurrent writes
- add CI integration test that simulates concurrent publisher and indexer writes

sre-oncall: INC-2026-078 created: monitoring concurrent finalize failures and throttling rewrite jobs. will post updates in the incident.

maria: release notes update: "Canary for ingest-worker (2026-05-02) held due to artifact digest mismatch between storage and index; pinned to 2026-05-01 to maintain release cadence. Investigation ARTIFACT-1521 opened."

release-manager: decision: pin applied for ingest-worker only; no global rollback. other services proceed. closing thread; follow-ups in ARTIFACT-1521/INC-2026-078. :white_check_mark:
